notes: db-tier-r2 (exit 1) is kept: the recorder's bare 'python' resolved to the base interpreter on Windows, so test children imported another checkout. The recorder now uses sys.executable; db-tier-r2b reran the command.
Pass-2 runs (r2, r2b) predate status_sha256, environment and run_context in the recorder; those fields are null for them.
After the r2 runs, usage_store._quietly's try/except/pass became contextlib.suppress(Exception) for bandit B110 (same behaviour); the r3 runs test the bytes with that change.

revert-postgres-r3 (exit 1) recorded one survivor, empty-frontier-trusted, then stopped at a stale anchor for gaps-unread. The new case test_an_empty_frontier_never_certifies_an_empty_scope kills the survivor; revert-postgres-r3b stopped at the same anchor, and revert-postgres-r3c ran all ten mutants with the anchor fixed.
boundary-*-r3 ran before that empty-scope case was added; it does not touch either boundary case.

task4-unit-acp (exit 1): the logging-surface audit failed on two new surfaces (an asyncio.Event set and a transport error's fixed code); both were registered, and task4-targeted reran the touched suites.
